title: OpenGDD v0.6 drawer label (_collection.json)

record.$comment: The optional record schema, in the closed field grammar SPEC 10.5 and 1b share: type (number, integer, string, grid), required or when (row domain), options, pattern, unique, description. The grammar's own rules are validator-level checks; with a schema present every record in the drawer is validated against it.
record.description: Optional record schema; field name to field shape

$comment: The label is optional and appears only when it has something to say (decision 33). record is its one field; a drawer with no label holds free-form designer data.
